summary: Completed requested backend+frontend verification for the admin origin bug. Updated admin regression tests to the new wildcard-origin + CSRF-proof contract and ran full suites (34/34 pass) against the preview backend. Preview /admin now shows login and works with password/session/proof flow. However, the REAL user domain https://lastzhood.fun/admin still shows the exact old rejection message and does not serve the same behavior as preview.

critical.issue: Live domain still enforces old origin restriction behavior: valid password login with required JSON + X-Admin-Client fails with 403 ('Bu kaynaktan yapılan isteğe izin verilmiyor.') for missing Origin and arbitrary HTTPS Origin, while preview returns 200.

ui_bugs.issue: Anonymous user still sees source-error message instead of login form on live user domain.
ui_bugs.selector: text=Bu kaynaktan yapılan isteğe izin verilmiyor.

integration_issues.issue: Live host appears out-of-sync with preview fix; /admin performs /api/admin/settings + /api/admin/refresh then lands on old origin error state. Data-testid login panel is absent on live.

action_items: Deploy/sync the same fixed backend/frontend build used by preview to lastzhood.fun.
Verify live /api/admin/login uses wildcard reflected origin contract with required headers (X-Admin-Client, JSON) and no fixed origin gate.
After deployment, re-run live-domain browser verification: anonymous /admin should render login panel, then login/read/logout should work.
Confirm live preflight allows X-Admin-Client and X-CSRF-Token headers (currently missing on live response).
critical_code_review_comments: Updated test_admin_api.py was required: old assertions expected 403 for missing/evil origin and old login response shape; those were obsolete and blocked valid regression coverage.
Preview implementation aligns with intended contract (proof + cookie, login header requirements, wildcard reflected CORS with credentials, lockout 429 on sixth failure).
Primary blocker is deployment/environment parity: live domain behavior and static asset/API behavior are inconsistent with the verified preview fix.
seed_data_creation: No persistent participant/agent test data created. Admin settings were temporarily changed in preview UI and restored to exact original value in the same session.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Evidence of live/preview mismatch captured. Preview URL: login works and enforces proof+cookie model. Live URL: still shows 'Bu kaynaktan yapılan isteğe izin verilmiyor.' and lacks admin login panel. Live loaded static bundle name observed as main.da706165.js during browser run.
rca of the issue: RCA: The code-level fix is effective on preview but not on the real user domain deployment path. Reproduction: (1) Open https://lastzhood.fun/admin -> old rejection message appears; no admin login panel. (2) POST live /api/admin/login with valid password, JSON, X-Admin-Client and either missing Origin or arbitrary HTTPS Origin -> 403 old rejection detail. (3) Same requests on preview return 200. Also live preflight returns 400 and omits required non-simple headers, unlike preview. Mitigation: deploy/sync corrected backend CORS+auth middleware and current frontend bundle to lastzhood.fun, then re-verify end-to-end on live host.
